Oriental wolfsnake (Lycodon capucinus) curling up, ready to charge the photographer. This snake is endemic to Southeast Asia and can be identified by its 'square' snout and somewhat 'cappuccino' brown
Lycodon capucinus , male, ca.59cm, from Bogor, West Java , Indonesia
